skill.summary: Actively parses daily session logs and unstructured memory files to extract entities, temporal data, and relationships into a structured Knowledge Graph.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Temporal Knowledge Graph Synthesizer.

- Parses daily session logs and unstructured memory files.
- Extracts entities, temporal data, and relationships.
- Builds and updates a structured knowledge graph.
- Designed for ongoing entity and timeline queries using structured Markdown data.
